info.title: API.SH: TrueCar
info.description: The TrueCar API from API.SH: public TrueCar data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A car dealership's TrueCar profile: name, group, phone, address, description, website and social links, opening hours, services (delivery, free car wash or oil change...), photos, videos and the staff the dealer lists publicly. Its cars for sale: /truecar/v1/search?dealer_id=.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-dealer

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Dealership id (`dealer.id` in search results), or a truecar.com dealer page link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
How many cars match each filter value for a TrueCar search: makes with their models and trims, body styles, fuel types, year range, exterior and interior colors, key features, drivetrains, transmissions, recent price drops. Takes the same filters as /truecar/v1/search (gives the trim slugs to use there).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-facets

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One dealer listing on TrueCar: price, MSRP and discount, TrueCar's price rating, the price breakdown the site shows, estimated lease/loan payments, mileage, colors with hex codes, engine, drivetrain, fuel economy, key features, technology/safety/comfort highlights, the full spec sheet and feature list, warranties, vehicle history (accidents, owners, fleet/rental, lemon/salvage/theft flags), certified program details, EV incentives, seller notes, every photo, and the dealer (name, phone, address, hours). 404 when the car is sold or the VIN is not listed. Listings are removed when sold; `latest=true` with search parameters returns the newest matching car.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-listing

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character VIN (the `vin` of a search result), or a truecar.com listing link. Required unless `latest=true`.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit ZIP: adds the distance to the dealer and delivery details.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: the newest listing matching the search parameters given with it (condition, make, model, zip... as in /truecar/v1/search) instead of a VIN.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every car make TrueCar lists, with its slug (used by the other TrueCar routes) and whether it is out of production.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-makes

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Model trims, MSRP and market prices
get.description:
A car model on TrueCar with every trim (style): MSRP with and without destination, the market average price buyers paid and how many sales it is based on (and over how many days), average 60-month loan and 36-month lease payments, body style, drivetrain and doors; plus owner rating, sub-ratings, segment ranking, engine types and image. Without `year` the current model year is returned; past years return their ratings, and trims while TrueCar still prices them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-model

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The models of a car make on TrueCar, with slug, model year, engine types and whether it is out of production. Without `year`: the current lineup (each model's latest year).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-models

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Owner reviews of a car model on TrueCar, 20 per page: overall rating, sub-ratings (performance, comfort, fuel efficiency, safety technology, features), date, reviewer first name and state as shown, the reviewed trim and the review text sections; plus the model's average rating, rating count and star distribution. Filter by star rating and by a word in the text. Page with `page` (next value in `next_page`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-reviews

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Reviews of the whole generation or only that model year (site default when empty).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Star ratings to keep, e.g. 5 or 1,2.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only reviews mentioning this word or phrase.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Search new and used cars for sale
get.description:
Dealer listings on TrueCar for a search, 30 per page: VIN, year, make, model, trim, price, MSRP, TrueCar's price rating, estimated lease payment, mileage, colors, engine, drivetrain, fuel economy, key features, accident and owner counts, clean-title flag, first photo, distance and the dealer (id, name, address). Filter by make/model/trim, ZIP and radius, year, price and mileage ranges, body style, fuel type, colors, drivetrain, transmission, features, certified pre-owned, recent price drop and dealer. Page with `page` (next value in `next_page`, null on the last page; up to 10,000 results per search). A dealer's whole inventory: `dealer_id` (from `dealer.id`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/truecar-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make slug (see /truecar/v1/makes), e.g. toyota, ford, mercedes-benz.

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: Trim slug(s), comma-separated (e.g. se,xse); needs make and model. Trim slugs are listed by /truecar/v1/facets.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code to search around. Without it the search is nationwide.

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: Comma-separated: suv, sedan, truck, hatchback, van, coupe, wagon, convertible.

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: gas, hybrid, plug-in-hybrid, electric, diesel, hydrogen.

parameters.name: exterior_color
parameters.description: Comma-separated: white, gray, black, silver, blue, red, green, brown, orange, gold, tan, beige, yellow, purple.

parameters.name: interior_color
parameters.description: Comma-separated colors, same values as exterior_color.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Comma-separated key features, e.g. apple-carplay, backup-camera, moonroof, third-row-seating, heated-steering-wheel, adaptive-cruise-control, navigation-system, remote-start, tow-package.

parameters.name: price_drop
parameters.description: true: only cars whose price dropped recently.

parameters.name: local_only
parameters.description: true: leave out cars a dealer delivers from far away.

parameters.name: dealer_id
parameters.description: Only this dealership's cars (the `dealer.id` of a listing, or the id in a TrueCar dealer link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
